name: Feature request

## The planning problem

Who encounters it, in which workflow, and what is difficult today?

## Desired behavior

Describe the explicit user choices and resulting behavior, with a small synthetic example.

## Existing alternatives

Which current workflow or workaround have you tried?

## Data and interaction impact

Mention any persistence, ownership, sync, import/export, accessibility or privacy boundary involved.
Avoid private plans or personal account details.
